The NHL is bringing the physicality in Week 5 and Week 6 of the 2026-27 season. Relive the hardest checks and biggest collisions, with glass-rattling contact and massive open-ice hits!
Connor McDavid absolutely wallpapers Leo Carlsson, Nikita Zadorov flattens Connor Bedard, Gabriel Landeskog sends Artyom Levshunov head over heels, Beck Malenstyn makes his presence felt, and Kris Letang and Evgeni Malkin deliver titanic hits on Beckett Sennecke.
Turn it up and FEEL THE HIT.
